name: Machine Pullover
instructions: Adjust the seat so that your shoulders are in line with the pivot point of the machine. Fasten the seat belt if the machine has one.
Put the backs of your upper arms or your elbows against the pads and hold the handles lightly. Let the pads move up and back until you feel a stretch in your lats.
Push the pads down and forward with your elbows in an arc until the bar or pads touch your torso.
Pause and squeeze your lats, then let the pads return slowly to the stretched position.
Keep your lower back against the seat for all the repetitions.
